player_prompt.intro:
Wiri Player {player_id} uchitamba gemu reCheckers semunhu {color}.
Tora shoko rako kwa tsamba dzechess [fileRank fileRank], somimba '[b2c3]' (chitataro a–h, tarakimu 0–7).
Mitanuro yepamutano:
  • Enda kudhiya pasi kwa 1 ikava shoko.
  • Tsunga kwa kufurura juu ropafunde rwevamwe.
  • Chikwata chinodhiwa kuwa King ikataura mwero wepamusoro.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hapana shoko rako peji rakawanda. Tsunga [a1b2], somimba [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Tsvuku haina zvimedu zvakasara. Nhema inohwina!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Vatema havana zvimedu zvakasara. Tsvuku inokunda!
